title: Concrete Crown
description: Boom-bap hip-hop instrumental in C minor at 90 BPM: swung dusty drums with ghost snares, a walking synth bass, jazzy electric-keys comping over Cm9-Abmaj7-Fm9-G7b9, and a mellow triangle lead with delay on the hooks (synth approximations of Rhodes, upright bass and flute; no vocals).
